we generated and characterized a new monoclonal antibody, 4B12, which specifically recognizes enterovirus 1A and 3D proteins.

a specific MAb against the 3CD protein of enterovirus A has been generated and used for the development of an immunodetection method for the direct detection of enterovirus infection in clinical samples.
